title: The Nest of Knives
text: A bird's nest woven of knives, blades and handles and broken swords, wedged in a dead tree. In it sit three eggs of iron, dull and heavy. Something above beats its wings, slow and huge, and every feather sounds like steel.

options.label: The quickest climbs for an iron egg while the wings beat somewhere above.

outcomes.text: An iron egg, warm and heavy and worth a fortune. Something above stops beating its wings.
The bird is not somewhere above. It is here.

options.label: Pull blades from the bottom of the nest, where the bird will not miss them.

outcomes.text: Fine blades, all of them, and one still holds a hand's warmth in the grip.

options.label: Leave the tree alone. Nothing that builds with knives should be crossed.

outcomes.text: Something with iron feathers watches you go, and drops one point-down in the earth beside you. Good iron, and a warning.
